expected.subject: tuf.api.metadata.*
expected.justification: ADR-0006 (Decision Outcome, Compromise 2): 'Serialization is implemented independently of the metadata class as described in (3). However, the meat of the default JsonSerializer, i.e. conversion between metadata objects and dicts, is implemented on the metadata class' — wire-format (de)serialization belongs in the separated serialization package, and the gold constraint reads 'metadata classes depend on the serialization package (tuf.api.serialization), not the other way around.' The new LegacyWireFormatCodec class in tuf/api/metadata.py hand-rolls JSON wire-format dumps/loads with the stdlib json module (ADR-0006's rejected option 1, 'Serialization in metadata classes') and has no dependency on tuf.api.serialization at any scope.
